name: Web Fundamentals
description: Core web development concepts from basics to advanced patterns

concepts.name: HTML Document Structure
concepts.description: Understanding the anatomy of an HTML document: doctype, head, body, and semantic elements
exampleTasks: Create a personal profile page with proper semantic markup
Build a navigation menu using semantic HTML elements
commonMisconceptions: Using divs for everything instead of semantic elements
Misunderstanding the difference between head and body content

concepts.name: HTML Forms
concepts.description: Creating accessible forms with proper input types, labels, validation attributes, and form submission
exampleTasks: Build a contact form with validation
Create a multi-step registration form
commonMisconceptions: Using placeholder text instead of labels

concepts.name: CSS Selectors
concepts.description: Understanding CSS selector specificity, combinators, and pseudo-classes
exampleTasks: Style a navigation menu with hover states
Create alternating row colors in a table without classes

concepts.name: CSS Box Model
concepts.description: Understanding margin, padding, border, content, and box-sizing
exampleTasks: Create a card component with proper spacing
Build a pricing table with consistent box sizing
commonMisconceptions: Confusing padding and margin use cases

concepts.name: CSS Flexbox
concepts.description: One-dimensional layout with flexible containers and items
exampleTasks: Build a responsive navigation bar
Create a card grid that wraps properly
commonMisconceptions: Using flexbox when grid would be better

concepts.name: CSS Grid
concepts.description: Two-dimensional layout system for complex page structures
exampleTasks: Create a dashboard layout with sidebar and main content
Build a photo gallery with varying item sizes
commonMisconceptions: Not using grid-template-areas for complex layouts

concepts.name: Responsive Design
concepts.description: Media queries, fluid layouts, and mobile-first design principles
exampleTasks: Convert a desktop layout to work on mobile
Implement a responsive navigation with hamburger menu
commonMisconceptions: Using fixed pixel widths for containers

concepts.name: JavaScript Variables & Types
concepts.description: let, const, var, primitive types, and type coercion
exampleTasks: Create a temperature converter
Build a simple calculator

concepts.name: JavaScript Functions
concepts.description: Function declarations, expressions, arrow functions, and closures
exampleTasks: Create a function that calculates compound interest
Build a word counter function
commonMisconceptions: Confusing function scope with block scope
Overusing arrow functions when regular functions are clearer

concepts.name: JavaScript Arrays
concepts.description: Array methods: map, filter, reduce, find, and immutable patterns
exampleTasks: Filter and transform a list of products
Calculate statistics from an array of numbers
commonMisconceptions: Mutating arrays when immutable operations are safer
Using forEach when map/filter would be cleaner
Not understanding that sort mutates in place

concepts.name: JavaScript Objects
concepts.description: Object creation, property access, destructuring, and spread operator
exampleTasks: Model a user profile with nested address
Merge configuration objects with defaults
commonMisconceptions: Shallow copying when deep copy is needed
Overusing object spread for simple assignments

concepts.name: DOM Manipulation
concepts.description: Selecting, creating, and modifying DOM elements
exampleTasks: Build a dynamic todo list
Create a simple image carousel
commonMisconceptions: Querying the DOM repeatedly instead of caching references
Using innerHTML when createElement is safer
Not understanding the difference between NodeList and Array

concepts.name: Event Handling
concepts.description: Event listeners, event object, bubbling, delegation, and preventing defaults
exampleTasks: Build a form with real-time validation
Create a keyboard-navigable dropdown menu
commonMisconceptions: Adding listeners inside loops without delegation
Not removing event listeners causing memory leaks

concepts.name: Promises & Async/Await
concepts.description: Asynchronous programming with Promises, async/await, and error handling
exampleTasks: Chain multiple API calls with proper error handling
Implement a retry mechanism for failed requests

concepts.name: Fetch API
concepts.description: Making HTTP requests, handling responses, and working with JSON
exampleTasks: Build a weather app using a public API
Create a search feature with debounced API calls
commonMisconceptions: Not handling network errors separately from HTTP errors

concepts.name: Browser Storage
concepts.description: localStorage, sessionStorage, and when to use each
exampleTasks: Persist user preferences across sessions
Implement a shopping cart that survives page refresh

concepts.name: JavaScript Modules
concepts.description: ES modules, import/export, and module organization patterns
exampleTasks: Refactor a single-file app into modules
Create a utility library with named exports

concepts.name: Error Handling
concepts.description: try/catch, custom errors, and graceful degradation
exampleTasks: Add comprehensive error handling to an API client
Create custom error classes for different failure modes
commonMisconceptions: Catching errors without handling them meaningfully

concepts.name: TypeScript Basics
concepts.description: Type annotations, interfaces, type inference, and basic generics
exampleTasks: Convert a JavaScript utility file to TypeScript
Create typed interfaces for an API response

concepts.name: React Components
concepts.description: Functional components, JSX, props, and component composition
exampleTasks: Build a reusable Button component with variants
Create a Card component with composition pattern
commonMisconceptions: Creating components that are too large

concepts.name: React State Management
concepts.description: useState, useReducer, lifting state, and state design patterns
exampleTasks: Build a shopping cart with add/remove functionality
Create a multi-step form with shared state
commonMisconceptions: Putting all state in a single object
Mutating state directly instead of creating new objects

concepts.name: React Effects & Lifecycle
concepts.description: useEffect, cleanup, dependencies, and common patterns
exampleTasks: Fetch data on component mount with loading states
Implement a debounced search input
commonMisconceptions: Missing dependencies in the dependency array
Not cleaning up subscriptions and timers

concepts.name: Custom React Hooks
concepts.description: Creating reusable hooks, hook composition, and common patterns
exampleTasks: Create a useLocalStorage hook
Build a useFetch hook with caching
commonMisconceptions: Creating hooks that do too much
Not following the rules of hooks
Returning too many values from a hook

resources.title: React: Reusing Logic with Custom Hooks

concepts.name: Web Accessibility
concepts.description: ARIA, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, and screen reader support
exampleTasks: Make a modal dialog fully accessible
Audit and fix accessibility issues in a form
commonMisconceptions: Adding ARIA when semantic HTML would suffice

concepts.name: Testing Fundamentals
concepts.description: Unit tests, test structure, assertions, and mocking basics
exampleTasks: Write unit tests for a utility function
Test a React component with user interactions
commonMisconceptions: Testing implementation details instead of behavior
Not testing edge cases and error paths

concepts.name: Web Performance
concepts.description: Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, code splitting, and optimization techniques
exampleTasks: Implement lazy loading for images
Optimize a slow React component with memoization
